title: O3K Helm chart values
description: Input contract for the O3K chart. helm install/upgrade/lint/template validate values against this schema and reject structurally invalid input before any workload is created. See charts/o3k/CONTRACT.md. Cross-field conditional requirements (e.g. credentials required unless an existing secret; the teardown image required under delete) are enforced at render time, not here.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names (default: the chart name).

image.description: Container image for the o3k binary.

repository.description: REQUIRED image repository, e.g. ghcr.io/your-org/o3k. No default — the chart pulls no implicit image (FR-018).

tag.description: Image tag — THE product version input. Selects which o3k build deploys; defaults to Chart.appVersion when empty. Open-ended (registry-defined), so no enum.

replicaCount.description: Single-node stub replicas. Real mode auto-pins to 1 (advisory).

database.description: External PostgreSQL reference. The chart deploys no database (FR-006). Provide url OR existingSecret.

url.description: PostgreSQL URL, e.g. postgres://user:pw@host:5432/o3k?sslmode=disable. Required unless existingSecret is set (enforced at render time).

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the DB URL (alternative to url); injected as O3K_DB_URL.

existingSecretKey.description: Key within existingSecret that holds the URL (default: url).

secrets.description: Sensitive values. Required unless secrets.existingSecret is supplied. Validation is PRESENCE-ONLY — strength is not enforced; existingSecret-provided values are never schema-validated.

jwtSecret.description: Token signing secret. Required unless existingSecret (render-time). No strength check — use a strong random value (guidance only).

adminPassword.description: Admin password. Required unless existingSecret (render-time). No strength check.

existingSecret.description: Operator-pre-rendered Secret with an o3k.yaml key (GitOps).

endpointHost.description: Advertised catalog host (O3K_ENDPOINT_HOST). REQUIRED for external consumers — the Keystone service catalog advertises this host; unset, it advertises localhost (unusable off-node). Empty = in-cluster only.

service.description: Front-door Service (the six API ports; metadata is node-local).

tls.description: Optional TLS at the exposure layer; sets the https catalog scheme.

certManagerIssuer.description: cert-manager (Cluster)Issuer name to auto-provision the cert.

storageMode.description: Storage backend (primary,fallback comma-separated). rbd,s3 is unsupported: Glance has no RBD backend, so the S3 replica would never be written — use local,s3.

s3.description: S3 / Ceph RGW backend (when storageMode includes s3). Credentials via AWS_* env, not here.

caBundle.description: In-container path to a PEM CA bundle for an internal-CA HTTPS RGW.

insecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS verification (test-only; never true in production).

realMode.description: Privileged real mode (libvirt + host access). Off by default.

applyPrivilegedNamespaceLabel.description: Label the namespace privileged (real mode only; FR-012d).

multiNode.description: Multi-node (DaemonSet) settings. Cross-node behavior is deferred (issue #52).

minProductVersion.description: Advisory-only minimum product-version floor (FR-010). NOT the deployed version — that is image.tag. Not enforced today.

redisUrl.description: Redis URL. In multi-node MUST be a single shared Redis (FR-006a).

dataRetentionPolicy.description: retain keeps all state on uninstall; delete runs the blocking pre-delete purge (SPEC-010).

teardown.description: Teardown hook settings. Effective only when dataRetentionPolicy: delete.

kubectlImage.description: kubectl image for the quiesce/PVC-delete Job. REQUIRED under delete (render-time). Must ship /bin/sh.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the o3k container (e.g. AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for the Glance s3 backend). Standard k8s env entries.

probes.description: Kubernetes health probes (SPEC-013), unauthenticated on the identity port: /readyz (DB-gated readiness), /livez (process-up liveness), and the OpenStack /healthcheck alias. Paths are fixed; tune timing/thresholds only.

startup.description: startupProbe -> /readyz. failureThreshold x periodSeconds is the slow-DB-connect boot grace before CrashLoopBackOff.

readiness.description: readinessProbe -> /readyz. Failure removes the pod from the Service (no restart).

liveness.description: livenessProbe -> /livez (process-up only; never the DB). Failure restarts the container.

drainSeconds.description: Graceful-shutdown drain pause (SPEC-013 FR-009): on SIGTERM o3k reports not-ready and waits this many seconds (so the EndpointSlice deregisters) before stopping. 0 disables.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod terminationGracePeriodSeconds; MUST exceed drainSeconds plus in-flight request time.
